scripts.script:
Stone and metal have collapsed across the chamber.

Broken slabs hang at impossible angles while debris chokes the passages beneath them. Every step must be chosen carefully, and what remains of the ceiling offers uncertain shelter from incoming fire.

Movement through this room will be slower.

The light dies as you enter.

Beyond a few meters, the chamber disappears into absolute black. Shapes become shadows, distances become uncertain, and even the tomb’s metallic walls seem to vanish into the void.

Whatever waits beyond the darkness is hidden from sight.

Something is leaking into the chamber.

Hissing liquid spills from ruptured conduits and spreads across the floor, eating into anything it touches. Only the shelter of the walls offers any protection from the corrosive spray.

Remaining exposed here will be dangerous.

Emerald energy arcs across the chamber.

Ancient conduits have split open, sending violent discharges crawling through the walls. The closer you move to the surrounding structure, the more violently the energy responds.

The room itself has become a weapon.

Warning indicators flare.

An invisible contaminant hangs in the air, released from systems sealed for untold millennia. Breathing becomes difficult. Muscles hesitate. Even simple actions demand an effort they did not moments before.

Something in this room is fighting you from within.

Time shifts.

For a moment, movement across the chamber becomes impossible to judge. Warriors seem to lurch forward between heartbeats, then hang motionless as the world crawls around them.

The flow of time here is no longer constant.

The floor gives way beneath you.

Ancient plates crack and collapse into the darkness below. Every sudden movement sends another section breaking loose, forcing the strike team to move with deliberate care.

Speed is a luxury this chamber will not allow.

Gravity twists.

Armor suddenly feels lighter. Bodies move farther with every step, yet weapons strike with strangely diminished force as the chamber’s distorted field pulls at everything within it.

The laws of weight and momentum have changed here.

An emerald field snaps into existence around the objective.

Light bends across its surface as the air shimmers with contained energy. Shots passing close to the device distort, their trajectories pulled aside by an invisible barrier.

The tomb is protecting anything that fights beneath its shield.

Electrical charge builds around the ancient device.

Arcs of energy crawl across the floor, searching for movement. The moment something crosses its influence, the chamber answers with a violent discharge.

Every sudden move risks awakening the storm.

Space folds around the objective.

For an instant, the chamber seems to exist in two places at once. Distance loses meaning as matter flickers between points that should be separated by meters of stone and metal.

The tomb has opened a path through space itself.

The dormant console awakens.

Streams of emerald symbols race across its surface as ancient command channels come back online. Somewhere deeper in the complex, systems begin responding to whoever controls this position.

This node offers access to the tomb’s command network.

Time thickens around the sphere.

Movement becomes strangely uneven. A warrior seems to surge forward between heartbeats, then hang motionless while the rest of the chamber continues around them.

Control of this device means control over the sequence of time itself.

The air around the objective begins to shimmer.

Edges sharpen. Blades hum. Matter seems less certain here, as though the boundary between solid metal and empty space has begun to weaken.

Weapons carried into the field suddenly feel far more dangerous.

Emerald light spills outward from the sphere.

Damaged armor begins knitting together. Failing systems stabilize. Wounds that should have been fatal seem to hesitate at the edge of death.

Something within this field refuses to let the fallen die.

The matrix erupts with power.

Energy races outward and gathers around nearby weapons, feeding them far beyond their normal limits. Barrels glow. Blades crackle. Every strike promises devastating force.

But power drawn from the tomb is never without risk.
